milestones.name: Reviewed Mac qualification plan
milestones.bar: A qualification plan for a shipped high-end game: every recovery and presentation claim has an observable proof on the named Mac target, respects C02/C06/C07 ownership and states what its instrumentation cannot establish.

items.statement: Independent review verifies runtime ownership, both Mac game outcomes and the limits of their instrumentation; the build plan links the qualification plan.
items.ask: Do the shared platform design, bounded-frame-host decision and Mac plan preserve one world clock, platform surface/device ownership and FrameHost submission/history ownership? Do the held-drawable recovery and slow-pan proofs distinguish authority, queue calls, GPU completion, display refresh and app-attributed presentation, without claiming unmeasured input-to-photon timing or taking over G3t/G4 or sibling platform work? Is this plan linked from G3b in docs/BUILD-PLAN.md?

milestones.name: The same Mac game resumes after graphics loss
milestones.bar: Recovery fit for a shipped high-end game: the same cooked noon valley, world, window and controls survive graphics loss. The same-build uninterrupted run is the exact paused-image oracle; the proposed Ground E noon view supplies intact composition, and normal-speed motion proves restored interaction.

items.statement: A Metal destroy with a drawable held recovers in the same PID/window without old-queue submit or present calls after destroy. Running authority commits ticks during loss before replacement submission; paused authority retains its tick, epoch, timeline and pause intent. Injected P/E use the normal app key handler, and Resume is acknowledged before arming the running row.
items.ask: Do the arm-disabled, paused-loss and running-loss rows use the same diagnostic binary, parameters and cooked generation? Trace held-drawable acquire/destroy/callback/abandon/replacement and every old-queue call including empty submits in the raw events and audit. Are same PID/window identity, injected P and Resume acknowledgement, ticks 80 and 81 before replacement submit, the paused endpoint and E's shared physical-key handler all established?

items.statement: All 2,073,600 paused pixels match before/after recovery and the same binary's arm-disabled control; independent normal-speed review identifies composited camera response after replacement submit/present in both loss rows.
items.inspect: Review the original arm-disabled, paused-loss and running-loss recordings at 1× beside the proposed Ground E noon reference. Inspect the pre-loss valley, recovery transition and post-replacement E response in both loss rows, using decoded transition frames as well as the complete motion. Confirm intact composition and an actual composited camera shift while the control holds framing; record capture gaps without treating recording PTS as panel cadence.
items.ask: Do the raw readbacks and audit establish equality of all 8,294,400 RGBA bytes across pre-loss, post-loss and arm-disabled paused endpoints, with matching acknowledged state and build identity?

milestones.name: The cooked valley presents smoothly on built-in ProMotion
milestones.bar: Coherent slow camera motion fit for a shipped high-end game in the cooked noon valley, reviewed at 1x from exact submitted engine output. Unattended elapsed-time runtime motion and attended built-in ProMotion cadence are separate required proofs. Record local holds and investigate visible hitches; no numeric performance threshold is a gate.

items.statement: The current release cooked noon valley retains coherent elapsed-time input-driven motion in an unattended real-time offscreen run, including both endpoint holds and the full two-second 0-to-36-degree pan. This qualifies engine runtime motion; it does not establish display-link, compositor or panel behavior. Final qualification uses the post-APPLE-TILE-M3 surface path; earlier runs must be rerun.
items.inspect: Using T2-CAPTURE M0, rerun the documented 1920x1080 pan with a paused world, 120 Hz requested opportunities and normal semantic controls while the console is locked and Screen Recording permission is unavailable. Review full-resolution source images, native-size crops and the host-time-preserving 1x movie against the proposed Ground E noon composition. Inspect rock, ridges and sphere together for continuity, framing, local holds, gross pauses, snaps or reversals. Verify actual monotonic timing, complete initial/final holds and full sweep, and join requested, accepted and submitted yaw to image/submission IDs. Capture omissions make the interval inconclusive. Do not substitute a fixed-step route, endpoint redraw or static parity. Preserve the historical 0d53d3aa motion pass and its 38.3/51.7 ms content holds as historical evidence only.

items.statement: ATTENDED SETUP: the current build's displayed frame intervals on the active built-in panel are independently attributable for the full pan, with app/window swaps separate from refresh and submission. An unlocked active display and any OS Instruments authorization are needed; an engine tap removes the Screen Recording grant requirement. Without fresh attributable swaps, cadence and the whole milestone remain open. Final qualification uses the post-APPLE-TILE-M3 surface path; earlier runs must be rerun.
items.inspect: On the unlocked built-in panel run matched release/noon/fixed-store untraced and Game Performance arms, with the same extent and input sweep through the normal AppKit slider target/action. Use T2-CAPTURE engine output for both arms, bracketing settled start, full pan and settled end; review original host-time-preserving 1x sequences for coherent content and record local holds. Require the same build/content identity as M2.1 or rerun it. Inspect a readable trace and displayed-surfaces-interval export: unique game window, PID, built-in display, resolved XML references and rotating surfaces into one unambiguous app-labelled stream. Use numeric Swap Time, not frame-label continuity. Align the full pan with same-process Points of Interest markers or a calibrated monotonic-clock join with correlated anchor and stated error. Record intervals, gaps/unmatched samples, display mode, build/recipe, run order/load and CPU/GPU rows; compare untraced control and report capture overhead. Trace finalization remains parked until separately resumed; this plan does not claim that blocker is solved. Leave the item open if export, attribution or alignment is ambiguous.
items.ask: Does the evidence distinguish callback target, opportunity, actor acquisition/submit, GPU completion, engine image/sample time, movie PTS, VSync and attributed compositor Swap Time? Is there independent OS attribution for this run/pan rather than the historical 5 November trace? Does attended setup name unlocked-display and any Instruments authorization needs without requiring the owner to play or grant Screen Recording for engine pixels? Engine pixels exclude native widgets/final compositor appearance: are those limits explicit, with any essential additional OS/physical observation separately attended and justified? Are input-to-photon and physical iPhone timing unmeasured, all interval figures observations, and the historical motion pass preserved without extending it to a new build?
